text:
incident-bot: PAGED: RID-CPU-THRESHOLD on router-prod-eu-3 — fired at 4850007777, count=1, severity=P2. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/RID-CPU-THRESHOLD

alex: acked. I'm on it.

jasmin: grabbing dashboards now — seeing a very short CPU spike on router-prod-eu-3, looks like a 20s blip around 4850007768-4850007788.

rohan: checking traces — tail latencies did spike for a handful of requests but 5xx count is 0. No user-facing errors in Sentry or frontend logs.

alex: thanks. can someone run the quick prom query? `sum(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{instance="router-prod-eu-3"}[1m])) by (mode)` — want to verify it's CPU user vs system.

jasmin: ran a targeted prom query, results inline: ```
# prom query: avg_over_time(cpu_usage_percent{instance="router-prod-eu-3"}[1m])
4850007760 => 22.4
4850007770 => 79.8
4850007780 => 24.1
```

jasmin: so yep sharp spike to ~80% for one minute bucket, then back to normal.

rohan: KV-cache warmup? any recent deployment to that node?

alex: no deploys in the last hour. autoscaler did a small burst yesterday but nothing now.

sre-shift-lead: I'm going to check infra alerts — maybe noisy synthetic canary hit that router specifically. @pagerduty-bot can you show the incident context?

pagerduty-bot: Context: alert triggered by CPU > 75% for 30s threshold on host router-prod-eu-3. Related incidents: none. Incidentbot runbook: quick-check -> metrics -> traces -> escalate if errors > 1% or 5xx > 0.

alex: given traces show no errors and prom shows single-node blip, I'm going to silence this rule for 90s for router-prod-eu-3 to avoid cascade. Will monitor.

jasmin: +1 to temporary silence. adding a note to the thread with reason.

alex: running silence: ```
# command
pdctl silence create --team infra --desc "transient cpu spike single host; silencing 90s" --service RID-CPU-THRESHOLD --host router-prod-eu-3 --duration 90s
# response
silence_id=slc_9f8a
```

incident-bot: Silence created slc_9f8a; will expire in 90s.

rohan: I'm watching tail latencies, nothing further. No 5xx, no customer sessions dropped.

sre-shift-lead: good. set an analyst note to follow up in the morning and add router-prod-eu-3 to the short-list for hardware/firmware checks if this repeats.

jasmin: adding note to the incident: "single-host CPU spike, likely noisy canary or batch job; no end-user impact observed; silenced for 90s; follow-up if recurrence."

alex: Incidentbot: mark as acknowledged and monitored.

incident-bot: ALERT: RID-CPU-THRESHOLD on router-prod-eu-3 AUTO-RESOLVED at 4850007860 — condition cleared.

jasmin: thanks — looks auto-resolved after the silence window.

rohan: logging this as a transient flapping page in the runbook. I'll attach the prom snippets and traces.

sre-shift-lead: action items: (1) add short-term suppression rule for single-host short spikes under 60s unless 5xx present, (2) monitor frequency over next 24h, (3) escalate if repeats >3 times in 24h. I'll create a ticket.

alex: nice and quiet. closing thread; tag me if it reappears. :white_check_mark: 

pagerduty-bot: Note: silence slc_9f8a expired. No further alerts for RID-CPU-THRESHOLD on router-prod-eu-3 in this window.

incident-bot: Thread closed by alex at 4850007890."
